quarterly_data.quarter: Evaxion Biotech press release: Evaxion applies its AI-Immunology platform in autoimmune (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Evaxion has begun applying its AI-Immunology platform in autoimmune diseases, expanding its therapeutic focus (a company milestone for 2026). It is experimentally testing two novel treatment concepts: a tolerogenic vaccine (vaccination with T-cell epitopes plus co-delivered immune modulators that direct the immune system to tolerance) and an autoantibody binder (an antigen construct that captures autoantibodies, the main pathogenic drivers in many autoimmune diseases). Company: both concepts could potentially offer higher efficacy and fewer side effects than current treatments; initial experimental data are to be presented in November 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: two treatment concepts in experimental testing
